policies.name: meas_delete
policies.using: ((owner = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ( SELECT private.is_admin() AS is_admin))

policies.name: meas_insert
policies.check: ((owner = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ( SELECT private.is_active() AS is_active))

policies.name: meas_select
policies.using:
((status = 'Onaylı'::text) OR ((( SELECT auth.role() AS role) = 'authenticated'::text) AND ((owner = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ( SELECT private.is_admin() AS is_admin) OR ((park_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM projects pr
  WHERE ((pr.id = measurements.project_id) AND (pr.park_id = measurements.park_id) AND (pr.owner = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM park_collaborators c
  WHERE ((c.park_id = measurements.park_id) AND (c.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))))))

policies.using: (((owner = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ( SELECT private.is_active() AS is_active)) OR ( SELECT private.is_admin() AS is_admin))

policies.name: collab_select
policies.using:
((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ( SELECT private.is_admin() AS is_admin) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM projects pr
  WHERE ((pr.park_id = park_collaborators.park_id) AND (pr.owner = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))

policies.name: invites_select
policies.using:
((invited_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (lower(email) = ( SELECT private.dg_current_verified_email() AS dg_current_verified_email)) OR ( SELECT private.is_admin() AS is_admin) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM projects pr
  WHERE ((pr.park_id = park_invites.park_id) AND (pr.owner = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))
